_comment: Audit item #27 CI security scanning. Each entry documents a pip-audit finding with no available fix, reviewed and accepted with a dated reason. Every other finding fails the gate.

allowed.reason: Path-traversal read (CVE-2026-12243) in nltk.data.load()/find() when called with an attacker-controlled resource name; no fix version exists upstream yet. nltk is a transitive dependency of rouge-score (dev-only summarization-quality test metric) — civiccast/ never imports nltk, and no runtime or CI path calls nltk.data.load()/find() with any input, let alone untrusted input. No fix version available as of this review; re-check when nltk publishes one.

pathsec sandbox bypass (CVE-2026-81726 / GHSA-8mgp-746c-j5xp) in nltk's model-artifact APIs — TransitionParser.train()/.parse(), AveragedPerceptron.save()/.load(), PerceptronTagger.save_to_json(), and save_maxent_params() use raw open() on caller-controlled paths instead of nltk.pathsec's guarded helpers, so a path outside an enforced pathsec root can still be read or written through these APIs. No fix version exists upstream as of this review (the reviewed GHSA still reports no patched versions, and pip-audit reports empty fix_versions for nltk 3.10.3). nltk is a transitive dependency of crawl4ai>=0.9.2 (civiccast/agenda_import/js_portal.py's optional JS-portal agenda-import adapter, pyproject.toml agenda-js-import extra) — civiccast/ never imports nltk directly (grep for `import nltk`/`from nltk` under civiccast/ and tests/ is empty). crawl4ai's sentence-tokenizer helper path requires a chunking/extraction strategy; current js_portal.py constructs CrawlerRunConfig(cache_mode=BYPASS) without either strategy. The vulnerable model-persistence APIs are not called by this configured crawl path or elsewhere in this repository. Re-check when nltk publishes a fix; reviewed 2026-10-08 and re-review by 2026-11-08.
